title: Runtime Is the New Security Frontier
author: Eliot Ferstl

title: Building Defense That Assumes Compromise
author: Eliot Ferstl
excerpt: Designing for a world where compromise is assumed changes what you build: it means planning for the moment defenses are already inside the perimeter.

title: 0.005% of What?

title: Three Silent Failures Between You and Sidecar Injection

excerpt: 'kubectl label deployment' writes to the Deployment's own metadata, not where pods get their labels. It reports success and nothing happens.

title: Why We Ship Our Security Webhook Fail-Open
author: Eliot Ferstl
excerpt: An admission webhook puts itself in the critical path of pod creation. 'failurePolicy' decides whose outage becomes yours. We ship fail-open.

excerpt: Our largest false positive soak is still running. Here are the definitions, thresholds and denominators, published before the data.

author: Eliot Ferstl

author: Eliot Ferstl
